title: docs/app/prototypes/<id>/bundle.json
description: A prototype bundle: one feature's handoff, linking its visual artifact, its real-component companion, its state inventory, the build spec, the decision record when there is one, and the intended ia.json. `fwos prototype promote` pins each of them; `fwos prototype diff` compares the intended IA with the real app.

id.description: The feature, the name of the bundle's folder.

pages.description: The ia.json pages this feature adds or changes: each needs a companion and a section in the state inventory.

visual.description: What it should look like: html or image files in the repository, a figma, storybook or url link (https), or a route in the app.

companion.description: Each page rendered from registered components: a route in the app (the screens browser's /fwos-screens/<page>) or a storybook story, naming its page.

states.description: The state inventory: a Markdown file with a ## section per page and a line per state (- <state>: what it shows).

spec.description: The build spec, a file with an optional #heading.

decision.description: The design decision record, when the feature has one: a file with an optional #heading or #<decision id>.

ia.description: The intended ia.json: the whole app's IA as this feature leaves it.

ref.description: A path from the project root, an https URL, or an app route.

page.description: For a companion: the page it renders.
